title: Verb + -ing (enjoy doing / stop doing etc.)
subtitle: Глаголы, после которых нужен -ing: enjoy, mind, avoid, give up…

theory.text: После некоторых глаголов второй глагол ставится только в форме -ing, а не с to: I enjoy cooking. (не enjoy to cook) Would you mind opening the window? Anna suggested going to the park.

items: give up — бросить, put off — откладывать, go on / carry on — продолжать, keep (on) — постоянно делать

theory.text: Отрицание — not + -ing: I enjoy not getting up early. Можно вставить человека: I can't imagine Paul dancing. Do you mind me using your phone? Sorry to keep you waiting.

О законченном действии можно сказать having done, но обычное -ing тоже верно: He denied taking the money. = He denied having taken the money. После admit, deny, suggest, recommend возможно и that: I recommend that you visit this museum.
Русское «предложить сделать» тянет к suggest to do — это ошибка. Правильно suggest doing или suggest that we do. Так же «бросить курить» — give up smoking, не give up to smoke.

en: I enjoy cooking at weekends.
I enjoy cooking on weekends.
I enjoy cooking at the weekend.
I like cooking at weekends.
I love cooking at weekends.
I like cooking on weekends.
I love cooking on weekends.
Would you mind opening the window?
Do you mind opening the window?
Anna suggested going to the park.
Anna suggested that we go to the park.
Anna suggested we go to the park.
The children suddenly stopped laughing.
Suddenly the children stopped laughing.
I've finished reading your book.
I finished reading your book.

items.ru: Он избегает отвечать на мои письма.
en: He avoids answering my emails.

en: I don't fancy going anywhere today.

en: Have you ever considered moving to Canada?

She admitted that she had broken the vase.
She admitted that she broke the vase.
I recommend visiting this museum.
I recommend that you visit this museum.
I recommend you visit this museum.
Don't risk losing your job.

items.ru: Можешь представить себе жизнь без интернета?
en: Can you imagine living without the internet?

items.ru: Мне нравится не вставать рано по воскресеньям.
en: I enjoy not getting up early on Sundays.

He gave up smoking.

He stopped smoking.

items.ru: Они продолжали разговаривать во время фильма.

They kept on talking during the film.

items.ru: Нельзя запретить людям говорить то, что они думают.
en: You can't stop people saying what they think.

Sorry to keep you waiting.

items.ru: Я жалею, что сказал ему это.
en: I regret telling him that.

items.ru: Ты не против, что я пользуюсь твоим телефоном?
en: Do you mind me using your phone?
Do you mind my using your phone?
